text:
Sam (CS): Quick heads-up: ClearSky reported 3 onboarding blockers and a couple feature asks in today's demo. Renewal review in ~5w. Can product/eng help prioritize?
Ivy (CS): Notes from the call:
- Relevance: their search returns vendor FAQs instead of internal SOPs after CSV ingest.
- Billing: want per-route toggles so support vs. analytics traffic billed separately.
- Import: large CSVs sometimes drop rows without error (they lost ~12k rows).
Hector (PM): Thanks. From product lens: relevance is P0 (blocks value), billing toggles P1 (sales ask), import robustness P2 but needs a clear error path. Any repros/ids?
Sam (CS): Sharing sanitized sample they gave:
```
{"text":"Nightly ventilator checklist","model":"redwood-sim-1.1","metadata":{"customer":"clearsky"}}
```
They used the UI CSV upload. Example request id: cs-req-2026-08-09-1147.
Mina (ENG): I'll take the relevance triage. Plan: repro with sample, check model routing and vectorstore mapping, and test nearest-neighbor scores. ETA 48h.
osps-bot: (typo) ops-bot: Created internal ticket CS-6201 and linked ENG-2456.
cs-bot: Added note to renewal risk board.
Hector (PM): For billing, product wants a short RFC. If we can't do per-route toggles quickly, can we offer a billing-segmentation workaround?
Mina (ENG): Interim mitigation: we can add a prefix filter to the ingestion pipeline that forces domain-specific tokenization and a tighter similarity threshold. Low-effort change; I can prototype in a day.
Ivy (CS): I'll propose that mitigation to ClearSky now and ask for permission to try on a sample dataset.
Hector (PM): Vote check: thumbs-up to fast-track relevance triage + prototype mitigation?
Sam (CS): :thumbsup:
Ivy (CS): :thumbsup:
Mina (ENG): :thumbsup:
Hector (PM): Noted. I'll draft the RFC for per-route billing but won't block renewal if the mitigation improves relevance.
Sam (CS): I'll add these points to the renewal memo and schedule a 30-min check-in with ClearSky after we have the prototype. Link to internal notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/clearsky-onboard-08-2026 (internal).
Mina (ENG): Starting repro now; will post findings here within 48h.
Sam (CS): Thanks team — keeping this open until ENG posts root cause.
